angle: A Korean launch begins with the actual service structure, not the server location.

marketing.targetReader: Overseas game companies and Korean publishers preparing a Korean launch
marketing.readerQuestion: Who is responsible for a Korean launch, and which steps come first when the server and company are overseas?
marketing.practicalPayoff: Readers can map the service structure through six questions and order the rating, registration, and domestic-agent reviews.
marketing.coverIntent: Use the Singapore server and absence of a Korean entity to pose a concrete responsibility question.
marketing.saveValue: Six launch-structure questions and the domestic-agent appointment thresholds
marketing.performanceHypothesis: Test whether a concrete service-structure question improves saves and profile visits.

editorialReview.reviewNote: Approved before pipeline v2.0; review completion was not backfilled

cards.oneMessage: The Korean service structure matters more than the server location.
cards.headline: Singapore server. No Korean entity. Who is responsible for the Korean launch?
body: What matters is who distributes the game and provides it to users in Korea.
cards.takeaway: Set the service structure first. The responsible parties follow from it.
cards.pageTurn: Why an overseas server does not end the analysis

sourceTrace.heading: 서론
sourceTrace.paragraph: 게임은 해외에서 만들었고 서버도 해외에 있는데
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Compressed the scenario into a direct English responsibility question.
sourceTrace.omittedQualification: The answer depends on the actual service structure.

cards.oneMessage: An overseas server does not remove the need to review Korean rating requirements.
cards.headline: Does an overseas server mean no Korean rating review?
body: Supreme Court of Korea · Case No. 2008Do3970 · Oct. 23, 2008
The Court held that, unless a statutory exception applies, the server's location in or outside Korea does not change the rating requirement.
Current independent rating classification and overseas-game provisions mean the ruling should not be applied mechanically to every launch.
cards.takeaway: An overseas server is not a safe reason to skip the Korean-law analysis.

sourceTrace.heading: 1. 서버가 해외에 있으면 한국 등급분류를 받지 않아도 될까요?
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Preserved both the holding and the present-law caveat; aligned the rating term with the statutory English translation.

cards.oneMessage: Four actors can have four different legal roles.
cards.headline: Separate four roles before planning a Korean launch
body: ① Overseas developer or publisher — owns the game or service rights
② Korean publisher — handles Korean service and distribution
③ Independent-rating business entity — platform designated to classify ratings
④ Domestic agent — statutory contact and compliance agent for qualifying overseas businesses
cards.takeaway: A Korean publisher and a domestic agent are not the same role.

sourceTrace.heading: 2. 해외게임 한국 출시에서 먼저 구분해야 할 주체는 4명입니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Reduced each role to its operative function and aligned statutory terms with the English Act.

cards.oneMessage: Foreign development alone does not trigger the overseas-game route.
cards.headline: Does every overseas game need a Korean publisher?
body: Potential overseas-game route: an existing global service adds Korea through an independent-rating business entity under the statutory conditions
Separate review needed: Korea is a core market from the outset, with a Korean-exclusive service and local contract structure
cards.takeaway: Being developed overseas does not automatically make Article 21-5 applicable.

sourceTrace.heading: 3. 해외게임은 반드시 국내 퍼블리셔를 선정해야 할까요?
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Converted the source examples into a parallel comparison and used the statutory English term.
sourceTrace.omittedQualification: Eligibility requires review of the actual service structure.

cards.oneMessage: The overseas-game exception and platform ratings do not carry over automatically.
cards.headline: Overseas-game exceptions and platform ratings do not carry over automatically
body: Article 21-5: adult-only games and games supplied to certain offline game businesses are outside this overseas-game route
Article 21-4: another independent-rating business entity must newly rate a game before distributing it
cards.takeaway: Review the distribution route together with the expected rating.
cards.pageTurn: Look at a Korean publisher's actual work

sourceTrace.heading: 4. 청소년이용불가 게임도 플랫폼을 통해 같은 방식으로 출시하면 될까요? / 5. 앱마켓 A에서 받은 등급을 플랫폼 B에서도 그대로 사용할 수 있을까요?
sourceTrace.paragraph: 게임의 유통경로와 예상등급을 함께 봐야 합니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Placed the two statutory boundaries in parallel and aligned the rating term with the English Act.

cards.oneMessage: A publisher's actual work matters more than its title.
cards.headline: When a Korean publisher joins, look at the work—not the label
body: Who imports the game?
Who owns or manages its copyright?
Who supplies it to game providers or others?
cards.takeaway: If it imports the game, or owns or manages its copyright while supplying it, review game-distribution-business registration.
cards.pageTurn: What a domestic representative does not replace

sourceTrace.heading: 6. 국내 퍼블리셔가 들어오면 누가 게임배급업 등록을 해야 할까요?

cards.oneMessage: A domestic agent does not replace a publisher or every rating procedure.
cards.headline: Does appointing a domestic agent complete every Korean procedure?
body: Core statutory duties: reports under Article 31(2) and game-labeling duties under Article 33
Not automatically replaced: the Korean publisher's role, game-distributing-business registration or every rating procedure
cards.takeaway: Appointment and launch completion are not the same thing.

sourceTrace.heading: 8. 2025년부터 생긴 국내대리인은 국내 퍼블리셔와 무엇이 다를까요?
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Contrasted assigned duties with matters not replaced and used the Act's 'domestic agent' terminology.

cards.oneMessage: The appointment criteria have three routes.
cards.headline: Which overseas game businesses must appoint a domestic agent?

body.text: Total revenue of at least KRW 1 trillion in the previous year
At least 1,000 average daily installs in the previous year on mobile devices sold in Korea
A ministerial reporting request over a serious risk to game-distribution order

cards.takeaway: Failure to appoint when required may result in an administrative fine of up to KRW 20 million.

sourceTrace.heading: 8. 2025년부터 생긴 국내대리인 / 9. 국내대리인을 지정하지 않으면
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Preserved the three criteria and fine, used 'domestic agent,' and shortened syntax without deleting a threshold.

cards.oneMessage: Six ordered questions reveal the Korean service structure.
cards.headline: Six questions to settle your Korean service structure
body: ① Who distributes the game?
② Who provides it to users?
③ Which platform is used?
④ Who handles the rating?
⑤ Who must register in Korea?
⑥ Who handles post-launch labeling and reports?
cards.takeaway: Once these answers are clear, the rating, registration and post-launch duties can be connected.
cards.pageTurn: The line between direct preparation and integrated review

sourceTrace.heading: 12. 한국 출시 전에 실제로는 어떤 순서로 정리해야 할까요?
sourceTrace.paragraph: 이 여섯 가지가 맞아야 한국 서비스 구조가 정리됩니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Converted the launch sequence into a saveable process.

cards.oneMessage: Separate direct preparation from situations that need integrated review.
cards.headline: What you may prepare directly—and what needs integrated review
body: Direct preparation: an existing global service, one independent-rating platform and a clear rating and distribution structure
Integrated review: a Korean publishing agreement, multi-platform launch, possible adult-only rating, random items, paid currency or a complex business model
cards.takeaway: A free review maps your service countries, platforms and contracts to the rating, registration and domestic-agent sequence.

sourceTrace.heading: 직접 준비할 수 있는 경우와 전문가 검토가 필요한 상황
sourceTrace.paragraph: 글로벌 서비스를 이미 운영 중인 해외 개발사
sourceTrace.compressionNote: Shortened the two decision labels and named the approved review inputs and outputs without expanding the service scope.
